fields.instructions: The pill above the headline. Blank hides the pill.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.name: hero_description
fields.default_value: Adlogix was founded on a simple realization: traditional advertising agencies lack technological depth, while traditional IT firms lack creative commercial storytelling. We bring both together under one roof.

fields.label: Title
fields.name: story_title
fields.default_value: Your Creative Growth Partner From Inception to Scale

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.name: story_paragraph_1
fields.default_value: We position Adlogix as an agile extension of your executive leadership team. Rather than treating marketing and software engineering as isolated silos, we orchestrate them into a unified growth engine.

fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.name: story_paragraph_2
fields.default_value: From testing high-velocity 9:16 vertical video reels to deploying headless React platforms and server-side first-party attribution tracking, we ensure every marketing rupee yields verifiable commercial ROI.

fields.label: Metric 1
fields.name: story_metric_1
fields.instructions: A metric needs a value. Clear the value to hide the tile.

fields.label: Story image
fields.name: story_image

fields.default_value: Adlogix leverages the technology capabilities and engineering infrastructure of Aumento Infoway. This partnership enables us to deliver enterprise-grade headless architectures, complex API middleware, high-concurrency cloud setups, and bulletproof web applications.
